name: valid-suite-empty-tags-nonempty-globs
description: A suite with an explicit empty tags array but a non-empty globs array is valid, and the empty array must round-trip as present, not be dropped.
yaml:
project: Demo
apps:
  - id: main
    platform: android
    appId: com.example.app
environments:
  staging:
    app: main
suites:
  smoke:
    tags: []
    globs: ["tests/**"]
